derivation: let φ := ObjectProperty.homMk p.c; letI : IsIso φ := TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis hB (fun i => h i); exact NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget _ _).map φ) (op U)
explanation: The Mathlib theorem says a morphism of sheaves is an isomorphism if it is an isomorphism on every member of a basis. Applying it to the sheaf morphism induced by `p.c`, then forgetting to presheaves and taking the component at `op U`, gives the claimed result. The target proof already uses this declaration.
